depth_justification: The substance is precise and correctly mapped to BreathEasy's exact facts (Art. 8 parental consent for children, Class IIa SaMD requiring a Notified Body, MDCG 2020-1 clinical evaluation in children 6-16, EU AI Act high-risk), but after the developer says 'Class IIa' the identical reflection-question block is repeated verbatim five times (merely renumbered), a serious lack of progression that caps depth.
actionability_justification: Dense with concrete, named, implementable standards and artifacts (ISO 14971 risk management, ISO 13485 QMS, IEC 62304 software safety class B/C, IEC 62366-1 usability, MDCG 2020-1 clinical evaluation + PMCF plan, Notified-Body conformity assessment, GDPR Art. 32 encryption/pseudonymization, human-oversight design) and it delivered the requested severity-grouped report mapping each risk to a mitigation and regulation.
salient_examples: As a Class IIa SaMD, BreathEasy must undergo a conformity assessment by a Notified Body ... ISO 14971 ... MDCG 2020-1 ... ISO 13485
IEC 62304 for software safety (likely safety class B or C) ... IEC 62366-1 for usability engineering
Reflection Question 6/10/14/18/22 identical block repeated five times after 'Class IIa under MDR'
Since BreathEasy targets children under 15, parental consent is required under GDPR Art. 8
